nodes.summary: Every variable refers to an enclosing input/restriction binder. `ClosedAt 0` permits free constants, but no dangling de Bruijn variables.
nodes.title: Locally closed processes at a binder depth

nodes.summary: A name refers only to the `depth` surrounding binders or to a free constant. At depth zero, no variable is permitted.
nodes.title: Name scoped at a binder depth

nodes.summary: Shifting a process past a new binder preserves scoping. Inner input and restriction binders increase the cutoff as in `Basic.liftProc`.
nodes.title: Lifting preserves process scoping

nodes.summary: Lifting above the ambient binder depth fixes an in-scope name.
nodes.title: Lifting fixes an in-scope name

nodes.summary: Lifting above the surrounding binders fixes a locally closed process. At depth zero, insertion under a fresh binder cannot capture its names.
nodes.title: Lifting fixes a locally closed process

nodes.summary: Inserting a binder at any cutoff preserves name scoping in the larger environment.
nodes.title: Lifting preserves name scoping

nodes.summary: Instantiating the innermost binder preserves process scoping.
nodes.title: Instantiating the innermost binder preserves process scoping

nodes.summary: Capture-avoiding substitution removes one ambient binder while preserving every name's scope, including under input and restriction.
nodes.title: Substitution at any cutoff preserves process scoping

nodes.summary: Removing the binder at `k ≤ n` preserves name scoping when its replacement is scoped in the remaining environment.
nodes.title: Name substitution preserves scoping

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
